questions.explanation: Null denotes unknown, not zero or empty string. Confusing them changes totals and counts. The distinction is fundamental.

questions.subject: DATA_SCIENCE
questions.topic: When the mean is the right fill
questions.learningObjective: Compute mean imputation for two values
questions.stem: An engineer fills a missing value with the mean of 25 and 35.
questions.explanation: The sum is 60 and the count is 2, so the mean is 30. Filling with 30 preserves the observed mean.
